summary: Passionate and detail-oriented Data Analyst and AI builder with deep expertise in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Star Schema), Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), Advanced Microsoft Excel, and SQL. Co-author of ByteLife real-time elderly health telemetry and published researcher in NLP micro-skill extraction (IJIRSET).

featured_projects.name: ByteLife - Early Detection & Intervention for the Aging Population
featured_projects.description: An end-to-end IoT and ML telemetry platform monitoring 5 vital signs in real time (Heart Rate, Systolic BP, Diastolic BP, SpO2, Temperature). Features a Random Forest Classifier with 99.78% accuracy and clinical rule failsafes to trigger immediate caregiver alerts with OTC medicine recommendations.

featured_projects.name: Detecting Micro Skills and Unlocking Macro Careers
featured_projects.description: Published paper in International Journal of Innovative Research in Science, Engineering and Technology (IJIRSET). Uses NLP and ML to parse resumes, verify micro-skills from GitHub and LeetCode activity, conduct automated gap analyses, and produce ATS-optimized career roadmaps.

featured_projects.name: Hospital Management Dashboard
featured_projects.description: Developed interactive Power BI dashboard tracking patient demographics, admission trends, length of stay, medical billing distributions, and clinical health indicators (BMI, BP, cholesterol). Implemented dynamic DAX measures and KPI scorecards.

featured_projects.name: Employee Performance Analytics Dashboard
featured_projects.description: Built an executive Excel performance dashboard utilizing Pivot Tables, dynamic slicers, KPI summary cards, and advanced formula modeling to optimize workforce allocation and performance reviews.

featured_projects.name: Smoking Behavior & Health Indicators Dashboard
featured_projects.description: Power BI analytical dashboard examining statistical correlations between smoking patterns and physiological markers like cholesterol, age groups, blood pressure, and cardiovascular risk.

featured_projects.name: Gesture-Controlled Virtual Mouse
